level_id_bank.verdict: Five-frame drop, ladders only (no drawn trade). The read: a 30% drawdown from the Jul-2026 high found support at 53 and bounced into the 60.0-62.4 pivot -- a cross-anchor fib pair stacked on the daily and weekly MA knot. Neutral until it resolves: a close above 62.4 targets 66.7, a close below 56.0 voids the bounce. Open call UJJIVANSFB-261117-pivot-decides.
